title: Train A work week
description: A fictional four-loop reference pressurised-water reactor held at full power, for planning a maintenance week on its Train A equipment. Planning reads the pumps' design values and running state, each with its read time, and never changes this simulation. The model has no maintenance, isolation or out-of-service state: taking equipment out happens only in the plan.
objectives: Link this simulation to the Train A work week plan, so the plan reads live pump state.
Compare the plan's assumptions with the plant's design values and running state.

steps.title: Link this simulation to the plan
steps.instruction: This simulation starts paused at full power. Open the Train A work week plan in Planning and link this simulation there. The plan then reads the pumps' running state and design values with their read time; reading never changes the plant.

steps.title: Inspect the plant
steps.instruction: Inspect the pumps the plan names, such as Service Water Pump A and B, and their live readings. Work in the plan is a forecast: the plant model has no maintenance or isolation state, so it shows no equipment taken out.
